[[File:Steel plateskirt detail.png|120px|left]]
The '''Steel plateskirt''' is a plateskirt made from steel, requiring level 5 [[Defence]] to wear. It can be made at level 46 [[Smithing]] by using 3 [[Steel bar]]s on an [[anvil]] with a [[hammer]] in the inventory. It has identical stats to the [[steel platelegs]], with the notable exception that it weighs less.
